prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Pájaros con mancuernas (shoulders_dumbbell_rear_delt_fly). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: De pie, inclina el tronco hacia delante desde la cadera con la espalda recta y rodillas suaves. Mancuernas colgando bajo el pecho. Sequence technique: Abre los brazos hacia los lados con los codos ligeramente flexionados. Sube hasta que los brazos queden en línea con la espalda. Baja con control sin perder la inclinación del tronco. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains two faceless medical teaching mannequins front and back in opaque gray sports suits with colored muscle overlays, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary deltoid muscles pale champagne. For overhead press focus anterior and middle deltoid, triceps secondary amber. For lateral raises focus lateral deltoid only, upper trapezius secondary. For rear fly focus POSTERIOR deltoid on back view, rhomboids secondary, not anterior shoulders. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
